push_result_unknown: Inspect remote commit/root before retry; never assume failed push implies no commit and never duplicate decision events.
context_loss: Recover from committed manifests, accepted returns and verified resumable checkpoints; conversation is cache only.
corruption: Use immutable hash-verified source; retain corrupt bytes as nonauthoritative diagnostic candidate without overwriting provenance.
repair: Only explicit controlled transaction; no silently repaired engineering values or missing historical packets.
rollback: Prefer forward compensating commit; never force-push or erase committed history. Reverting Phase8A requires exact published hash and confirmation no later dependents/root transactions exist; otherwise explicit reviewed compensation.
checkpoints: Persist task ID/pin/generation/profile, read_set, completed immutable chunks, pending work, V&V/conflicts/open frontiers/provenance and resume key.
r1_recovery: R1 was never published; no R1 rollback is required. Discard publication candidacy; preserve rejected artifact only as nonauthoritative audit evidence.
